102	# --- Proxy helpers (generic) ---
103	# Portable proxy management: honor $LOCAL_PROXY_URL, else prefer an active
104	# Clash config, else auto-probe common loopback ports (Clash 7890/7891,
105	# ClashX 1087, Privoxy 8118, generic 8080). Detection result is cached
106	# per-shell in _NET_PROXY_CACHE; use `proxy-refresh` after
107	# starting/stopping the proxy.
108	#
109	# Environment variables honored:
110	#   LOCAL_PROXY_URL         HTTP/HTTPS proxy URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890).
111	#                           If unset, ports are auto-probed.
112	#   LOCAL_PROXY_SOCKS_URL   Optional separate SOCKS5 endpoint (e.g.
113	#                           socks5://127.0.0.1:7891). Used for ALL_PROXY /
114	#                           all_proxy when set; otherwise these fall back to
115	#                           LOCAL_PROXY_URL / the probe result. Useful when
116	#                           Clash is configured with split `port:` and
117	#                           `socks-port:` instead of `mixed-port:`.
118	#   LOCAL_PROXY_AUTO_ACTIVATE=1  Run `proxy-on` silently at shell startup
119	#                           whenever a proxy is detected. Handy on machines
120	#                           that always route through the local proxy.
121	
122	: "${_NET_PROXY_CACHE:=}"
123	: "${_NET_PROXY_SOCKS_CACHE:=}"
124	: "${_NET_PROXY_SOURCE_CACHE:=}"
125	# Verge mixed-port defaults to 7897; Ubuntu mihomo bring-up often uses 17890
126	# while legacy CFW still holds 7890/7891.
127	__NET_PROXY_PROBE_PORTS=(7897 7890 7891 17890 1087 8118 8080)
128	__NET_PROXY_CLASH_CONFIG_CANDIDATES=(
129	  "$HOME/Library/Application Support/io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev/config.yaml"
130	  "$HOME/Library/Application Support/io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev/clash-verge.yaml"
131	  "$HOME/.config/mihomo/config.yaml"
132	  "$HOME/.config/clash/config.yaml"
133	  "$HOME/.config/clash/config.yml"
134	  "$HOME/Library/Application Support/clash/config.yaml"
135	  "$HOME/Library/Application Support/clash/config.yml"
136	)
137	
138	__net_clear_proxy_cache() {
139	  _NET_PROXY_CACHE=""
140	  _NET_PROXY_SOCKS_CACHE=""
141	  _NET_PROXY_SOURCE_CACHE=""
142	}
143	
144	__net_set_proxy_cache() {
145	  _NET_PROXY_CACHE="$1"
146	  _NET_PROXY_SOCKS_CACHE="$2"
147	  _NET_PROXY_SOURCE_CACHE="$3"
148	}
149	
150	__net_port_open() {
151	  nc -z -w1 127.0.0.1 "$1" 2>/dev/null
152	}
153	
154	__net_find_clash_config() {
155	  local candidate
156	  for candidate in "${__NET_PROXY_CLASH_CONFIG_CANDIDATES[@]}"; do
157	    if [[ -f "$candidate" ]]; then
158	      printf '%s\n' "$candidate"
159	      return 0
160	    fi
161	  done
162	  return 1
163	}
164	
165	__net_yaml_scalar() {
166	  local key="$1"
167	  local config_path="$2"
168	  awk -v key="$key" '
169	    {
170	      line = $0
171	      sub(/\r$/, "", line)
172	      if (line ~ /^[[:space:]]*#/) {
173	        next
174	      }
175	      sub(/[[:space:]]+#.*/, "", line)
176	      if (line ~ "^[[:space:]]*" key ":[[:space:]]*") {
177	        sub("^[[:space:]]*" key ":[[:space:]]*", "", line)
178	        gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", line)
179	        gsub(/^["'"'"']|["'"'"']$/, "", line)
180	        print line
181	        exit
182	      }
183	    }
184	  ' "$config_path"
185	}
186	
187	# macOS: honor the *active* System Settings proxy when it points at a live
188	# loopback port. Clash Verge / CFW "System Proxy" writes here; Node/bun do NOT
189	# read it — only curl/scutil consumers do — but it is still the best signal of
190	# which local port the user intends right now (beats a stale ~/.config/clash).
191	__net_detect_system_proxy() {
192	  command -v scutil >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
193	  local host port enable
194	  enable="$(command scutil --proxy 2>/dev/null | command awk '/HTTPEnable/ {print $3; exit}')"
195	  [[ "$enable" == "1" ]] || return 1
196	  host="$(command scutil --proxy 2>/dev/null | command awk '/HTTPProxy/ {print $3; exit}')"
197	  port="$(command scutil --proxy 2>/dev/null | command awk '/HTTPPort/ {print $3; exit}')"
198	  [[ -n "$host" && -n "$port" ]] || return 1
199	  # Only auto-trust loopback / explicit local proxies — never silently route
200	  # shell helpers through a remote corporate proxy discovered via scutil.
201	  case "$host" in
202	    127.0.0.1|localhost|::1) ;;
203	    *) return 1 ;;
204	  esac
205	  __net_port_open "$port" || return 1
206	  __net_set_proxy_cache \
207	    "http://127.0.0.1:$port" \
208	    "socks5://127.0.0.1:$port" \
209	    "macOS system proxy"
210	  return 0
211	}
212	
213	__net_detect_clash_proxy() {
214	  local config_path mixed_port http_port socks_port socks_url="" source_label
215	  # Prefer a config whose declared port is *actually listening* — an old CFW
216	  # yaml sitting next to a live Verge instance used to win and report a dead
217	  # 7891 while traffic was on 7897.
218	  local candidate
219	  for candidate in "${__NET_PROXY_CLASH_CONFIG_CANDIDATES[@]}"; do
220	    [[ -f "$candidate" ]] || continue
221	    config_path="$candidate"
222	    source_label="clash/mihomo config"
223	    case "$candidate" in
224	      *clash-verge*) source_label="clash-verge config" ;;
225	      */mihomo/*)    source_label="mihomo config" ;;
226	    esac
227	
228	    mixed_port="$(__net_yaml_scalar "mixed-port" "$config_path")"
229	    if [[ -n "$mixed_port" ]] && __net_port_open "$mixed_port"; then
230	      __net_set_proxy_cache \
231	        "http://127.0.0.1:$mixed_port" \
232	        "socks5://127.0.0.1:$mixed_port" \
233	        "$source_label"
234	      return 0
235	    fi
236	
237	    http_port="$(__net_yaml_scalar "port" "$config_path")"
238	    socks_port="$(__net_yaml_scalar "socks-port" "$config_path")"
239	    if [[ -n "$http_port" ]] && __net_port_open "$http_port"; then
240	      socks_url=""
241	      if [[ -n "$socks_port" ]] && __net_port_open "$socks_port"; then
242	        socks_url="socks5://127.0.0.1:$socks_port"
243	      fi
244	      __net_set_proxy_cache \
245	        "http://127.0.0.1:$http_port" \
246	        "$socks_url" \
247	        "$source_label"
248	      return 0
249	    fi
250	  done
251	
252	  return 1
253	}
254	
255	__net_detect_proxy() {
256	  if [[ -n "$LOCAL_PROXY_URL" ]]; then
257	    __net_set_proxy_cache \
258	      "$LOCAL_PROXY_URL" \
259	      "$LOCAL_PROXY_SOCKS_URL" \
260	      "LOCAL_PROXY_URL env"
261	    return 0
262	  fi
263	  # Cache hit (including cached "none") — skip re-probe until proxy-refresh.
264	  if [[ -n "$_NET_PROXY_CACHE" ]]; then
265	    [[ "$_NET_PROXY_CACHE" == "none" ]] && return 1
266	    return 0
267	  fi
268	  if __net_detect_system_proxy; then
269	    return 0
270	  fi
271	  if __net_detect_clash_proxy; then
272	    return 0
273	  fi
274	  local port
275	  for port in "${__NET_PROXY_PROBE_PORTS[@]}"; do
276	    if __net_port_open "$port"; then
277	      __net_set_proxy_cache "http://127.0.0.1:$port" "socks5://127.0.0.1:$port" "probe"
278	      return 0
279	    fi
280	  done
281	  __net_set_proxy_cache "none" "" "probe"
282	  return 1
283	}
284	
285	# Resolve the URL that should be used for ALL_PROXY / all_proxy.
286	# Falls back to the HTTP proxy when no SOCKS-specific URL is set (works for
287	# mixed-port Clash configs where one port serves both HTTP and SOCKS).
288	__net_all_proxy_url() {
289	  if [[ -n "$LOCAL_PROXY_SOCKS_URL" ]]; then
290	    printf '%s\n' "$LOCAL_PROXY_SOCKS_URL"
291	  elif [[ -n "$_NET_PROXY_SOCKS_CACHE" ]]; then
292	    printf '%s\n' "$_NET_PROXY_SOCKS_CACHE"
293	  else
294	    printf '%s\n' "$_NET_PROXY_CACHE"
295	  fi
296	}
297	
298	# Run one command with proxy env applied to the child process only.
299	withproxy() {
300	  __net_detect_proxy
301	  if [[ "$_NET_PROXY_CACHE" == "none" ]]; then
302	    "$@"
303	    return
304	  fi
305	  local all_url
306	  all_url="$(__net_all_proxy_url)"
307	  http_proxy="$_NET_PROXY_CACHE" \
308	  https_proxy="$_NET_PROXY_CACHE" \
309	  HTTP_PROXY="$_NET_PROXY_CACHE" \
310	  HTTPS_PROXY="$_NET_PROXY_CACHE" \
311	  ALL_PROXY="$all_url" \
312	  all_proxy="$all_url" \
313	    "$@"
314	}
315	
316	# Run direct first; on non-zero exit, retry via proxy if one is available.
317	try_direct_then_proxy() {
318	  "$@" && return 0
319	  local rc=$?
320	  __net_detect_proxy
321	  if [[ "$_NET_PROXY_CACHE" == "none" ]]; then
322	    return $rc
323	  fi
324	  printf '%s\n' "[retry via proxy $_NET_PROXY_CACHE]" >&2
325	  withproxy "$@"
326	}
327	
328	# Export proxy env vars to the current shell (all downstream commands inherit).
329	# If $1 is "-q", suppress the success message (used by auto-activate).
330	proxy-on() {
331	  local quiet=0
332	  [[ "$1" == "-q" ]] && quiet=1
333	  __net_detect_proxy
334	  if [[ "$_NET_PROXY_CACHE" == "none" ]]; then
335	    (( quiet )) || printf '%s\n' "proxy-on: no proxy detected (set \$LOCAL_PROXY_URL or start your proxy, then \`proxy-refresh\`)" >&2
336	    return 1
337	  fi
338	  local all_url
339	  all_url="$(__net_all_proxy_url)"
340	  export http_proxy="$_NET_PROXY_CACHE" \
341	         https_proxy="$_NET_PROXY_CACHE" \
342	         HTTP_PROXY="$_NET_PROXY_CACHE" \
343	         HTTPS_PROXY="$_NET_PROXY_CACHE" \
344	         ALL_PROXY="$all_url" \
345	         all_proxy="$all_url"
346	  if (( ! quiet )); then
347	    if [[ "$all_url" == "$_NET_PROXY_CACHE" ]]; then
348	      printf '%s\n' "proxy ON  ->  $_NET_PROXY_CACHE"
349	    else
350	      printf '%s\n' "proxy ON  ->  http/https=$_NET_PROXY_CACHE  all/socks=$all_url"
351	    fi
352	  fi
353	}
354	
355	# Unset all proxy env vars from the current shell.
356	proxy-off() {
357	  unset http_proxy https_proxy HTTP_PROXY HTTPS_PROXY ALL_PROXY all_proxy NO_PROXY no_proxy
358	  __net_clear_proxy_cache
359	  printf '%s\n' "proxy OFF"
360	}
361	
362	# Report current proxy state: active / available / unavailable.
363	proxy-status() {
364	  __net_detect_proxy
365	  local shell_active=""
366	  if [[ -n "$http_proxy$https_proxy$ALL_PROXY" ]]; then
367	    shell_active="yes"
368	  fi
369	  local source="${_NET_PROXY_SOURCE_CACHE:-probe}"
370	
371	  if [[ "$_NET_PROXY_CACHE" == "none" ]]; then
372	    printf '%s\n' "proxy: unavailable (no \$LOCAL_PROXY_URL; no loopback port from ${__NET_PROXY_PROBE_PORTS[*]} reachable)"
373	    [[ -n "$shell_active" ]] && printf '%s\n' "  note: shell env still has proxy vars set -- run \`proxy-off\` to clear"
374	    return 1
375	  fi
376	
377	  local state="available"
378	  [[ -n "$shell_active" ]] && state="active   "
379	  local hint="(not exported; use \`withproxy\`, \`try_direct_then_proxy\`, or \`proxy-on\`)"
380	  [[ -n "$shell_active" ]] && hint="(exported in current shell)"
381	  local all_url all_source
382	  all_url="$(__net_all_proxy_url)"
383	  all_source="$source"
384	  [[ -n "$LOCAL_PROXY_SOCKS_URL" ]] && all_source="LOCAL_PROXY_SOCKS_URL env"
385	
386	  printf '%s\n' "proxy: $state http=$_NET_PROXY_CACHE  source=$source  $hint"
387	  if [[ -n "$all_url" && "$all_url" != "$_NET_PROXY_CACHE" ]]; then
388	    printf '%s\n' "  socks=$all_url  source=$all_source"
389	  fi
390	}
391	
392	# Validate that the detected proxy can actually reach the public internet.
393	# ICMP ping does not honor proxy env vars, so use Google's HTTP 204 endpoint.
394	proxy-test() {
395	  local url="${1:-https://www.google.com/generate_204}"
396	  if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
397	    printf '%s\n' "proxy-test: curl not found" >&2
398	    return 127
399	  fi
400	
401	  __net_detect_proxy
402	  if [[ "$_NET_PROXY_CACHE" == "none" ]]; then
403	    printf '%s\n' "proxy-test: no proxy detected (set \$LOCAL_PROXY_URL or start your proxy, then \`proxy-refresh\`)" >&2
404	    return 1
405	  fi
406	
407	  local all_url
408	  all_url="$(__net_all_proxy_url)"
409	  printf '%s\n' "proxy-test: http=$_NET_PROXY_CACHE  all=$all_url  url=$url"
410	  withproxy curl -sS -o /dev/null \
411	    -w 'proxy-test: http=%{http_code} remote=%{remote_ip} total=%{time_total}s\n' \
412	    --max-time 10 "$url"
413	}
414	
415	# Clear the cached detection and re-probe; call after toggling your proxy.
416	proxy-refresh() {
417	  __net_clear_proxy_cache
418	  __net_detect_proxy
419	  proxy-status
420	}
421	
422	# Optional auto-activation: when $LOCAL_PROXY_AUTO_ACTIVATE=1 is set before
423	# this file is sourced, silently call `proxy-on` if a proxy is detected.
424	# Set the env var in a machine-local shell file (or ~/.zshenv / ~/.profile) on
425	# machines that should always route through the loopback proxy.
426	if [[ "$LOCAL_PROXY_AUTO_ACTIVATE" == "1" ]]; then
427	  proxy-on -q
428	fi
429	
430	# --- Rootless Docker socket ---
431	# Point the Docker CLI at the user-scoped socket when rootless Docker is
432	# installed. Without this, `docker` defaults to /var/run/docker.sock (the
433	# rootful path) and fails with "Cannot connect to the Docker daemon".
434	# Guarded on socket existence so this is a no-op on:
435	#   - macOS (OrbStack / Docker Desktop publish their own sockets, don't need this)
436	#   - Linux boxes still running rootful Docker (the rootful socket is under /var/run)
437	# Respect a pre-existing $DOCKER_HOST so a user-set value wins.
438	# See docs/tools/container-config-map.md for the full install-variant map.
439	if [[ "$(uname -s)" == "Linux" && -z "$DOCKER_HOST" ]]; then
440	  _net_xdg_runtime="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$UID}"
441	  if [[ -S "${_net_xdg_runtime}/docker.sock" ]]; then
442	    export DOCKER_HOST="unix://${_net_xdg_runtime}/docker.sock"
443	  fi
444	  unset _net_xdg_runtime
445	fi
