```text
1	# 43_copilot_proxy.sh - GitHub Copilot -> Anthropic/OpenAI proxy for Claude Code
2	#   (shared bash + zsh).
3	#
4	# Runs the maintained copilot-api fork (caozhiyuan/copilot-api, npm
5	# @jeffreycao/copilot-api) so a GitHub Copilot subscription can back Claude Code
6	# (and any OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible client). The original ericc-ch/copilot-api
7	# is unmaintained (its issue #233 points at the fork) but still works via
8	# COPILOT_API_PKG=copilot-api@0.7.0 — flags differ per package, see
9	# _copilot_pkg_flavor. Both packages share the same token file, so switching
10	# needs no re-auth. Full guide + risks: docs/tools/copilot-claude-proxy.md.
11	#
12	# Public surface:
13	#   copilot-proxy [start|stop|status|restart|doctor|logs|whoami|auth]  - manage the proxy
14	#   copilot-proxy doctor [--live]  - diagnose prereqs/auth/proxy/model-entitlement/
15	#                                upstream; --live sends one real request. The
16	#                                model-entitlement check catches the common
17	#                                "400 model_not_supported" case, where a Copilot
18	#                                plan serves no Anthropic models at all — that
19	#                                looks like a network fault in the logs but is an
20	#                                account-policy fact.
21	#   copilot-run <cmd...>       - run any command with the proxy env injected
22	#                                (auto-starts the proxy first)
23	#   claude-copilot [args...]   - one-off Claude Code session on the proxy
24	#                                (specstory-wrapped when available; zero file writes)
25	#   claude-copilot-once [args...] - one-shot session via the copilot-here pin
26	#                                (settings.local.json; auto-reverted, even on Ctrl-C)
27	#   copilot-here [on|off|status] - sticky per-project toggle via the gitignored
28	#                                ./.claude/settings.local.json (never touches the
29	#                                committed .claude/settings.json)
30	#   copilot-model [<id>|-l|-c|--auto] - switch the pinned model (edits settings.local.json
31	#                                when copilot-here is on, else the global state file;
32	#                                --auto = Claude > Codex > GPT > Gemini from served list)
33	#
34	# Settings-layer design (why settings.local.json / env vars, and NOT the
35	# committed .claude/settings.json nor ~/.claude/settings.json):
36	#   - ~/.claude/settings.json is chezmoi-managed (dot_claude/modify_settings.json)
37	#     and would make the proxy always-on for every project.
38	#   - ./.claude/settings.json is committed (claude-plans-here puts plansDirectory
39	#     there) — proxy config must not leak into git.
40	#   - Claude Code precedence (low→high): user < project < settings.local.json
41	#     (gitignored) < CLI flags. GOTCHA (verified 2026-07): current Claude Code
42	#     lets the settings.local.json env block BEAT inherited shell env vars —
43	#     so copilot-run/claude-copilot cannot override a project where
44	#     `copilot-here on` points elsewhere (run `copilot-here off` first).
45	#
46	# Portability notes (POSIX subset, both shells source this file):
47	#   - the pinned package is INSTALLED ONCE into _copilot_pkg_prefix and the proxy
48	#     runs that binary directly. It deliberately does NOT use `bunx` at launch:
49	#     bunx re-resolves the package on every start, and bun stalls forever
50	#     resolving through a socks ALL_PROXY — which wedged `start` at "Resolving
51	#     dependencies" AND kept bun's global cache lock, so every retry hung too.
52	#     See pitfalls/copilot-proxy-start-hangs-at-resolving-dependencies.md.
53	#     Override the spec with COPILOT_API_PKG; force a re-install with
54	#     `copilot-proxy reinstall`.
55	#   - no ZLE/compdef/setopt/glob-qualifiers here (bash would error on source).
56	#
57	# Env (set in ~/.shellrc.adhoc or ~/.config/{zsh/secrets.zsh,bash/secrets.sh}):
58	#   COPILOT_PROXY_PORT   default: 4141        - port the proxy listens on
59	#   COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY   default: auto        - Node→GitHub /models egress:
60	#                          auto   = if proxy-status finds Clash/Verge/mihomo (or
61	#                                   macOS System Proxy), start with --proxy-env
62	#                                   + HTTPS_PROXY. Node ignores System Proxy;
63	#                                   TUN/Mixin used to hide this on GFW hosts.
64	#                          always = same, but warn when no local proxy is found
65	#                          never  = never pass --proxy-env (non-GFW machines)
66	#                          http://127.0.0.1:PORT = force that URL
67	#   COPILOT_API_PKG      default: @jeffreycao/copilot-api@1.13.14
68	#                                             - package spec to install (pin/
69	#                                               upgrade; copilot-api@0.7.0 = old
70	#                                               original). Changing it re-installs.
71	#   COPILOT_PROXY_RATE   default: 15          - --rate-limit seconds; ONLY used
72	#                                               by the original package (the fork
73	#                                               has no rate limiter)
74	#   COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET  default: 0           - 1 = inject extra quota-saving env
75	#                                               (fewer background calls, but a
76	#                                               slightly degraded Claude Code UX)
77	
78	# --- shared constants / helpers -------------------------------------------------
79	
80	_copilot_port() { printf '%s' "${COPILOT_PROXY_PORT:-4141}"; }
81	_copilot_pkg()  { printf '%s' "${COPILOT_API_PKG:-@jeffreycao/copilot-api@1.13.14}"; }
82	
83	# CLI flavor from the package spec: the ORIGINAL bare `copilot-api` takes
84	# --rate-limit/--wait and has `check-usage`; the fork (and anything else)
85	# doesn't. Strips a trailing @version, but not the @scope/ prefix.
86	_copilot_pkg_flavor() {
87	  local name; name="$(_copilot_pkg)"
88	  case "$name" in
89	    copilot-api|copilot-api@*) printf 'original' ;;
90	    *) printf 'fork' ;;
91	  esac
92	}
93	_copilot_base() { printf 'http://localhost:%s' "$(_copilot_port)"; }
94	_copilot_logfile() { printf '%s' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-api-$(_copilot_port).log"; }
95	_copilot_pidfile() { printf '%s' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-api-$(_copilot_port).pid"; }
96	
97	# --- pinned package install (run the binary, never `bunx` at launch) -------------
98	#
99	# Why an install prefix instead of `bunx <pkg> start`: bunx re-resolves the
100	# package on EVERY launch, and bun hangs indefinitely resolving through a socks
101	# ALL_PROXY (curl through the same proxy is fine, which is what makes it so
102	# confusing). The wedged installer then keeps bun's global cache lock, so every
103	# retry hangs identically and stacks another zombie. Installing once and exec'ing
104	# the resulting binary removes the per-start resolve entirely — a warm start does
105	# zero network before it binds the port. Full story:
106	# pitfalls/copilot-proxy-start-hangs-at-resolving-dependencies.md
107	
108	# Package NAME without the trailing @version, keeping any @scope/ prefix.
109	# The naive "${spec%@*}" eats the whole string on a scoped spec with no version
110	# (@jeffreycao/copilot-api -> ""), so test on the scope-stripped copy.
111	_copilot_pkg_name() {
112	  local spec base
113	  spec="$(_copilot_pkg)"
114	  base="${spec#@}"
115	  case "$base" in
116	    *@*) printf '%s' "${spec%@*}" ;;
117	    *)   printf '%s' "$spec" ;;
118	  esac
119	}
120	
121	_copilot_pkg_prefix() { printf '%s' "${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/copilot-api/pkg"; }
122	_copilot_pkg_bin()    { printf '%s' "$(_copilot_pkg_prefix)/node_modules/.bin/copilot-api"; }
123	# Records the spec the prefix currently holds, so bumping COPILOT_API_PKG (or the
124	# pinned default) re-installs instead of silently running the old version.
125	_copilot_pkg_stamp()  { printf '%s' "$(_copilot_pkg_prefix)/.installed-spec"; }
126	
127	# Is the CURRENTLY pinned spec installed and runnable?
128	_copilot_pkg_ready() {
129	  local bin stamp
130	  bin="$(_copilot_pkg_bin)"; stamp="$(_copilot_pkg_stamp)"
131	  [ -x "$bin" ] || return 1
132	  [ -f "$stamp" ] || return 1
133	  [ "$(command head -n 1 "$stamp" 2>/dev/null)" = "$(_copilot_pkg)" ]
134	}
135	
136	# One `bun add` attempt in $1. $2 = "noproxy" strips the proxy env, anything else
137	# honours it. $3 = seconds budget, enforced by polling — `timeout(1)` is not in
138	# macOS base, and this file is sourced by both shells. Returns 124 on expiry.
139	#
140	# The kill on expiry is the load-bearing part: a stalled `bun add` left running
141	# keeps bun's global install-cache lock, and THAT is what made every subsequent
142	# start hang too. Never let one escape.
143	_copilot_pkg_install_try() {
144	  local dir="$1" mode="$2" budget="$3" pkg pid i=0
145	  pkg="$(_copilot_pkg)"
146	  if [ "$mode" = "noproxy" ]; then
147	    ( cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null && command env \
148	        -u ALL_PROXY -u all_proxy -u HTTP_PROXY -u http_proxy \
149	        -u HTTPS_PROXY -u https_proxy \
150	        bun add "$pkg" --no-summary >/dev/null 2>&1 ) &
151	  else
152	    ( cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null && command bun add "$pkg" --no-summary >/dev/null 2>&1 ) &
153	  fi
154	  pid=$!
155	  while [ "$i" -lt "$budget" ]; do
156	    if ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
157	      wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null
158	      return $?
159	    fi
160	    sleep 1
161	    i=$((i + 1))
162	  done
163	  # Braces + 2>/dev/null swallow the shell's own async "Killed" job notification:
164	  # we report the timeout ourselves, and a raw job-control message here reads like
165	  # a crash. Kill the whole process group's `bun add` too — the subshell's child
166	  # is the one actually holding the cache lock.
167	  { kill -9 "$pid" 2>/dev/null
168	    command pkill -9 -f "bun add.*$(_copilot_pkg_name)" 2>/dev/null
169	    wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null
170	  } 2>/dev/null
171	  return 124
172	}
173	
174	# Ensure the pinned spec is installed. No-op (and no network) once it is.
175	_copilot_ensure_pkg() {
176	  local spec prefix bin
177	  spec="$(_copilot_pkg)"; prefix="$(_copilot_pkg_prefix)"; bin="$(_copilot_pkg_bin)"
178	
179	  _copilot_pkg_ready && return 0
180	
181	  if ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then
182	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: bun not found (needs bun via mise)." >&2
183	    return 1
184	  fi
185	  command mkdir -p "$prefix" || return 1
186	  # A private package.json keeps `bun add` from walking up and polluting $HOME.
187	  [ -f "$prefix/package.json" ] || printf '%s\n' \
188	    '{"name":"copilot-api-runner","private":true,"version":"0.0.0"}' >"$prefix/package.json"
189	
190	  printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: installing $spec (one-time — later starts skip this) ..."
191	  # Attempt 1 honours the ambient env: on a host where the npm registry is only
192	  # reachable THROUGH the proxy, stripping it would break the install. Attempt 2
193	  # strips it, which is what rescues the socks stall. COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY=1
194	  # skips straight to attempt 2 (saves the 45s stall on a known-bad host).
195	  if [ "${COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY:-0}" = "1" ] \
196	     || ! _copilot_pkg_install_try "$prefix" env 45; then
197	    if [ "${COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY:-0}" != "1" ]; then
198	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: install stalled with the proxy env — retrying without it ..." >&2
199	      # Drop bun's cache lock dir before retrying; the killed attempt may have
200	      # left it behind, and a stale lock hangs the retry for the same reason.
201	      command rm -rf -- "${BUN_INSTALL:-$HOME/.bun}/install/cache/.tmp" 2>/dev/null
202	    fi
203	    if ! _copilot_pkg_install_try "$prefix" noproxy 90; then
204	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: could not install $spec — run 'copilot-proxy doctor'." >&2
205	      return 1
206	    fi
207	  fi
208	
209	  if [ ! -x "$bin" ]; then
210	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: install finished but $bin is missing." >&2
211	    return 1
212	  fi
213	  printf '%s\n' "$spec" >"$(_copilot_pkg_stamp)"
214	}
215	
216	# --- throttle shim (optional, in front of the fork) -----------------------------
217	# A tiny Bun reverse proxy that caps concurrent in-flight upstream requests and
218	# transparently retries 403/429 (GitHub enterprise abuse throttling) BEFORE any
219	# body streams — so downstream agents never see "Please run /login". Toggle with
220	# `copilot-proxy shim on|off`; tune via COPILOT_SHIM_{PORT,MAX,RETRIES,BACKOFF_MS}.
221	_copilot_shim_port()    { printf '%s' "${COPILOT_SHIM_PORT:-4142}"; }
222	_copilot_shim_base()    { printf 'http://localhost:%s' "$(_copilot_shim_port)"; }
223	_copilot_shim_script()  { printf '%s' "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/shell/copilot-throttle-shim.js"; }
224	_copilot_shim_logfile() { printf '%s' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-shim-$(_copilot_shim_port).log"; }
225	_copilot_shim_pidfile() { printf '%s' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-shim-$(_copilot_shim_port).pid"; }
226	_copilot_shim_state()   { printf '%s' "${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/copilot-proxy/shim"; }
227	
228	# Enabled? env COPILOT_PROXY_SHIM overrides a persisted on/off state file.
229	_copilot_shim_enabled() {
230	  case "${COPILOT_PROXY_SHIM:-}" in
231	    1|on|true|yes)  return 0 ;;
232	    0|off|false|no) return 1 ;;
233	  esac
234	  local sf; sf="$(_copilot_shim_state)"
235	  [ -f "$sf" ] && [ "$(command head -n1 "$sf" 2>/dev/null)" = "on" ]
236	}
237	
238	# Is the shim port answering at all? (curl w/o -f: any HTTP reply = exit 0, so a
239	# 502 from a fork-down passthrough still counts as "shim process is up".)
240	_copilot_shim_alive() {
241	  command curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 2 "$(_copilot_shim_base)/v1/models" >/dev/null 2>&1
242	}
243	
244	# Base URL Claude Code should talk to: the shim when it's enabled AND actually
245	# up, otherwise the fork directly (never break just because the shim is down).
246	_copilot_client_base() {
247	  if _copilot_shim_enabled && _copilot_shim_alive; then _copilot_shim_base; else _copilot_base; fi
248	}
249	
250	# Base URL for PERSISTENT pins (copilot-here settings.local.json): the shim when
251	# it's enabled (it's auto-started with the proxy, so it'll be up when in use),
252	# else the fork. Not gated on currently-alive since the file outlives this shell.
253	_copilot_pinned_base() {
254	  if _copilot_shim_enabled; then _copilot_shim_base; else _copilot_base; fi
255	}
256	
257	# Start the shim (idempotent). Points it at the fork; inherits COPILOT_SHIM_*.
258	_copilot_shim_start() {
259	  if _copilot_shim_alive; then return 0; fi
260	  if ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then
261	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim needs 'bun' (via mise) — skipping." >&2
262	    return 1
263	  fi
264	  local script; script="$(_copilot_shim_script)"
265	  if [ ! -f "$script" ]; then
266	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim script not found at $script" >&2
267	    return 1
268	  fi
269	  COPILOT_SHIM_PORT="$(_copilot_shim_port)" COPILOT_SHIM_UPSTREAM="$(_copilot_base)" \
270	    nohup bun "$script" >"$(_copilot_shim_logfile)" 2>&1 &
271	  printf '%s\n' "$!" >"$(_copilot_shim_pidfile)"
272	  local i=0
273	  while [ "$i" -lt 10 ]; do
274	    _copilot_shim_alive && return 0
275	    sleep 1; i=$((i + 1))
276	  done
277	  printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim did not come up — check $(_copilot_shim_logfile)" >&2
278	  return 1
279	}
280	
281	# Stop the shim.
282	_copilot_shim_stop() {
283	  local pidf; pidf="$(_copilot_shim_pidfile)"
284	  if [ -f "$pidf" ]; then
285	    local pid; pid="$(command cat "$pidf" 2>/dev/null)"
286	    [ -n "$pid" ] && kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null
287	    command rm -f -- "$pidf"
288	  fi
289	  command pkill -f "copilot-throttle-shim.js" 2>/dev/null
290	  return 0
291	}
292	
293	# Global default-model state file (used by copilot-run/claude-copilot when the
294	# project has no copilot-here pin). Written by `copilot-model`.
295	_copilot_model_state() {
296	  printf '%s' "${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/copilot-proxy/model"
297	}
298	
299	# Resolve the model for env injection: $COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL > state file > default.
300	#
301	# Model-id shape matters (verified 2026-07):
302	#   - HYPHENATED ids (claude-opus-4-8), not dotted (claude-opus-4.8): Claude
303	#     Code only recognizes hyphenated family names — dotted ids fall back to
304	#     a legacy "[Opus 4] retired" label AND a 200k context assumption.
305	#   - "[1m]" suffix: Copilot serves opus-5 / opus-4-8 / sonnet-5 with a 1M context
306	#     window; the suffix makes Claude Code strip it, send the context-1m
307	#     beta header, and size HUD/compaction to 1M (otherwise it assumes 200k
308	#     and shows >100% context). Claude Code-only: raw API clients must send
309	#     the plain id — the proxy rejects a literal "...[1m]" model.
310	_copilot_default_model() {
311	  if [ -n "${COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL:-}" ]; then
312	    printf '%s' "$COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL"
313	  elif [ -f "$(_copilot_model_state)" ]; then
314	    command head -n 1 "$(_copilot_model_state)"
315	  else
316	    printf '%s' "claude-opus-5[1m]"
317	  fi
318	}
319	
320	# Is the proxy answering on its port?
321	_copilot_alive() {
322	  command curl -fsS --max-time 2 "$(_copilot_base)/v1/models" >/dev/null 2>&1
323	}
324	
325	# --- doctor helpers -------------------------------------------------------------
326	
327	# Every model id the proxy will accept: the raw `.id` PLUS the `.claude_model_id`
328	# alias (which is the one carrying the "[1m]" suffix Claude Code sends). Checking
329	# only `.id` — as _copilot_model_list does — would reject a valid "...[1m]" pin.
330	_copilot_served_models() {
331	  local json
332	  json="$(command curl -fsS --max-time 5 "$(_copilot_base)/v1/models" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
333	  if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
334	    printf '%s\n' "$json" | jq -r '.data[] | .id, (.claude_model_id // empty)' 2>/dev/null | command sort -u
335	  else
336	    printf '%s\n' "$json" \
337	      | command grep -oE '"(id|claude_model_id)":"[^"]*"' \
338	      | command sed 's/.*":"//;s/"//' | command sort -u
339	  fi
340	}
341	
342	# The model Claude Code would actually send from THIS directory, and where it
343	# came from. Mirrors copilot-model's precedence: project pin > $COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL
344	# > state file > built-in default. Echoes "<model>|<source>" ('|' never occurs in
345	# a model id or a path we emit here).
346	_copilot_effective_model() {
347	  local settings=".claude/settings.local.json" m
348	  if [ -f "$settings" ] && command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 \
349	     && [ "$(jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL // empty' "$settings" 2>/dev/null)" != "" ]; then
350	    m="$(jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL // empty' "$settings" 2>/dev/null)"
351	    if [ -n "$m" ]; then printf '%s|%s' "$m" "project pin: $settings"; return 0; fi
352	  fi
353	  if [ -n "${COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL:-}" ]; then
354	    printf '%s|%s' "$COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL" '$COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL'
355	  elif [ -f "$(_copilot_model_state)" ]; then
356	    printf '%s|%s' "$(command head -n 1 "$(_copilot_model_state)")" "state file: $(_copilot_model_state)"
357	  else
358	    printf '%s|%s' "$(_copilot_default_model)" "built-in default"
359	  fi
360	}
361	
362	# HTTP reachability probe. Any HTTP status means the host answered — an
363	# unauthenticated 400/401 from the Copilot API is a SUCCESSFUL reach. Only a
364	# connect/read failure is a fault. Echoes "<code>|<seconds>", empty on failure.
365	# $2, when non-empty, routes through that proxy (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7891).
366	_copilot_probe() {
367	  local url="$1" via="${2:-}" out
368	  if [ -n "$via" ]; then
369	    out="$(command curl -o /dev/null -s -w '%{http_code}|%{time_total}' --max-time 12 -x "$via" "$url" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
370	  else
371	    out="$(command curl -o /dev/null -s -w '%{http_code}|%{time_total}' --max-time 12 --noproxy '*' "$url" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
372	  fi
373	  case "$out" in 000*) return 1 ;; esac
374	  printf '%s' "$out"
375	}
376	
377	# Model ids GitHub serves for this account RIGHT NOW.
378	#
379	# Why this exists: copilot-api fetches /models ONCE at startup and caches it for
380	# the whole process lifetime. A degraded OR geo-filtered startup fetch leaves
381	# the proxy serving a truncated list forever, and every request for a missing
382	# model returns a 400 "model_not_supported" that looks exactly like an
383	# entitlement problem. Comparing live-upstream against proxy-cached is the only
384	# way to tell those apart. Verified 2026-07.
385	#
386	# $1 selects the egress path for the curl probe (curl follows the macOS system
387	# proxy by default — which is exactly what made the old doctor mis-diagnose
388	# "entitlement" when System Proxy was ON but Node was going direct):
389	#   (empty)           — curl defaults (may use System Proxy on macOS)
390	#   direct            — --noproxy '*' (true direct egress)
391	#   http://host:port  — force -x that proxy
392	#
393	# Secrets: the ghu_/bearer tokens are passed via `curl -K -` (stdin config), NOT
394	# argv — argv is world-readable via `ps`. Never echo either token.
395	_copilot_upstream_models() {
396	  local via="${1:-}"
397	  local tokfile="$HOME/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token"
398	  [ -f "$tokfile" ] || return 1
399	  command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
400	
401	  local ghu ex api ctok up
402	  ghu="$(command head -n 1 "$tokfile" 2>/dev/null)"
403	  [ -n "$ghu" ] || return 1
404	
405	  # Transport: keep as one argv word so zsh doesn't glob `*`.
406	  local xargs=()
407	  case "$via" in
408	    "") ;;
409	    direct) xargs=(--noproxy '*') ;;
410	    http://*|https://*|socks5://*|socks5h://*) xargs=(-x "$via") ;;
411	    *) return 1 ;;
412	  esac
413	
414	  # bash arrays work when this file is sourced from bash; zsh too. Avoid
415	  # unquoted $* expansion of `--noproxy *`.
416	  ex="$(printf 'header = "Authorization: token %s"\n' "$ghu" \
417	        | command curl -fsS --max-time 10 -K - \
418	            -H 'user-agent: GitHubCopilotChat/0.26.7' \
419	            "${xargs[@]}" \
420	            https://api.github.com/copilot_internal/v2/token 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
421	
422	  api="$(printf '%s' "$ex" | jq -r '.endpoints.api // "https://api.githubcopilot.com"' 2>/dev/null)"
423	  ctok="$(printf '%s' "$ex" | jq -r '.token // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
424	  [ -n "$ctok" ] || return 1
425	
426	  up="$(printf 'header = "Authorization: Bearer %s"\n' "$ctok" \
427	        | command curl -fsS --max-time 12 -K - \
428	            -H 'user-agent: GitHubCopilotChat/0.26.7' \
429	            -H 'copilot-integration-id: vscode-chat' \
430	            "${xargs[@]}" \
431	            "$api/models" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
432	
433	  printf '%s' "$up" | jq -r '.data[]?.id // empty' 2>/dev/null | command sort -u
434	}
435	
436	# Resolve the HTTP(S) proxy URL that Node should use for GitHub /models.
437	# Prints a URL or nothing. Never prints secrets. Relies on 50_networking.sh
438	# helpers when available; falls back to macOS System Proxy / common ports.
439	#
440	# COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY:
441	#   auto|always|never|<url>
442	_copilot_resolve_http_proxy() {
443	  local mode="${COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY:-auto}"
444	  case "$mode" in
445	    never|off|0|false|no) return 0 ;;
446	    http://*|https://*|socks5://*|socks5h://*)
447	      printf '%s' "$mode"
448	      return 0
449	      ;;
450	    always|auto|on|1|true|yes|"") ;;
451	    *)
452	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: unknown COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY='$mode' (use auto|always|never|http://...)" >&2
453	      return 0
454	      ;;
455	  esac
456	
457	  # Prefer the shared detector (Clash Verge / mihomo / CFW / System Proxy).
458	  if command -v __net_detect_proxy >/dev/null 2>&1; then
459	    if __net_detect_proxy 2>/dev/null \
460	       && [ -n "${_NET_PROXY_CACHE:-}" ] \
461	       && [ "$_NET_PROXY_CACHE" != "none" ]; then
462	      printf '%s' "$_NET_PROXY_CACHE"
463	      return 0
464	    fi
465	  fi
466	
467	  # Fallback when 50_networking.sh isn't sourced yet (rare; file order is 43→50).
468	  local sys
469	  sys="$(_copilot_system_proxy)"
470	  if [ -n "$sys" ]; then
471	    printf '%s' "http://$sys"
472	    return 0
473	  fi
474	  return 0
475	}
476	
477	# Normalise a model id for cross-source comparison: lowercase, dots -> dashes
478	# (upstream says claude-opus-4.8, the proxy says claude-opus-4-8), drop the
479	# Claude Code-only "[1m]" suffix. Reads ids on stdin, one per line.
480	_copilot_norm_models() {
481	  command tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | command sed 's/\[1m\]$//; s/\./-/g' | command sort -u
482	}
483	
484	# macOS system HTTP proxy as "host:port", empty when disabled/not macOS.
485	_copilot_system_proxy() {
486	  command -v scutil >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
487	  command scutil --proxy 2>/dev/null | command awk '
488	    /HTTPEnable/ { en=$3 } /HTTPProxy/ { h=$3 } /HTTPPort/ { p=$3 }
489	    END { if (en == 1 && h != "" && p != "") printf "%s:%s", h, p }'
490	}
491	
492	# PIDs of bun package-installer processes still resolving copilot-api, one per
493	# line (empty when none). bun stalls indefinitely resolving through a socks
494	# ALL_PROXY (even when curl to the same registry is fine), and a stalled
495	# `bun add` keeps bun's global install-cache lock — which wedges every later
496	# install too. _copilot_pkg_install_try now bounds and kills its own attempts, so
497	# this should stay empty; it remains as a safety net for a stall we didn't spawn
498	# (a hand-run `bunx @jeffreycao/copilot-api`, or a zombie left by the pre-install
499	# design that resolved on every launch). A live `bun add … copilot-api` is never
500	# normal at rest — install is a one-shot — so a match is a clean signal.
501	# Verified 2026-07: five stacked zombies from five retries, none ever bound the port.
502	_copilot_stale_installers() {
503	  command pgrep -f 'bun add.*copilot-api' 2>/dev/null
504	}
505	
506	# --- proxy manager --------------------------------------------------------------
507	
508	# Manage the copilot-api proxy. Subcommands: start|stop|status|restart|logs|auth.
509	# Example:
510	#   copilot-proxy start          # background-start on $COPILOT_PROXY_PORT
511	#   copilot-proxy status         # is it up? which models?
512	copilot-proxy() {
513	  if [ -n "$ZSH_VERSION" ]; then
514	    emulate -L zsh
515	    setopt localoptions pipefail
516	  else
517	    set -o pipefail
518	  fi
519	
520	  if ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then
521	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: bun not found (needs bun via mise)." >&2
522	    return 1
523	  fi
524	
525	  local port pkg logf pidf
526	  port="$(_copilot_port)"; pkg="$(_copilot_pkg)"
527	  logf="$(_copilot_logfile)"; pidf="$(_copilot_pidfile)"
528	
529	  local action="${1:-status}"
530	  case "$action" in
531	    start)
532	      if _copilot_alive; then
533	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: already running on port $port" >&2
534	        return 0
535	      fi
536	      # First run needs `copilot-proxy auth` to store a ghu_ token; warn if absent.
537	      if [ ! -f "$HOME/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token" ]; then
538	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: not authenticated yet — run 'copilot-proxy auth' first." >&2
539	        return 1
540	      fi
541	      # Rotate the previous session's log (keep last 3) so a restart doesn't wipe
542	      # it — the start commands below truncate ($logf) via `>`. logf.1 = previous
543	      # session, logf.2/.3 = older. Debugging a transient (e.g. 403) survives.
544	      if [ -f "$logf" ]; then
545	        command rm -f "$logf.3" 2>/dev/null
546	        [ -f "$logf.2" ] && command mv -f "$logf.2" "$logf.3"
547	        [ -f "$logf.1" ] && command mv -f "$logf.1" "$logf.2"
548	        command mv -f "$logf" "$logf.1"
549	      fi
550	      # Install the pinned package BEFORE backgrounding anything. Resolving it at
551	      # launch (the old `bunx <pkg> start`) is what used to hang forever behind a
552	      # socks proxy, with nothing but "Resolving dependencies" in the log.
553	      _copilot_ensure_pkg || return 1
554	      local bin srv_pid http_proxy_url use_proxy_env=0
555	      bin="$(_copilot_pkg_bin)"
556	      http_proxy_url="$(_copilot_resolve_http_proxy)"
557	      if [ -n "$http_proxy_url" ]; then
558	        use_proxy_env=1
559	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: Node will fetch /models via $http_proxy_url (--proxy-env; COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=${COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY:-auto})"
560	      else
561	        case "${COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY:-auto}" in
562	          always|on|1|true|yes)
563	            printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=always but no local proxy detected — starting DIRECT (Claude catalog may be geo-filtered)." >&2
564	            printf '%s\n' "  hint: start Clash Verge / mihomo, or set COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7897" >&2
565	            ;;
566	        esac
567	      fi
568	
569	      # Flag sets differ per package: only the original has --rate-limit/--wait
570	      # (the fork ships no rate limiter — mitigate with COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET=1).
571	      # --proxy-env makes Node honour HTTPS_PROXY (macOS System Proxy alone is ignored).
572	      if [ "$(_copilot_pkg_flavor)" = "original" ]; then
573	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: starting ($pkg) on port $port (rate-limit ${COPILOT_PROXY_RATE:-15}s) ..."
574	        # Original package: HTTPS_PROXY alone is enough (no --proxy-env flag).
575	        if [ "$use_proxy_env" -eq 1 ]; then
576	          nohup env HTTP_PROXY="$http_proxy_url" HTTPS_PROXY="$http_proxy_url" \
577	            http_proxy="$http_proxy_url" https_proxy="$http_proxy_url" \
578	            "$bin" start \
579	            --port "$port" \
580	            --rate-limit "${COPILOT_PROXY_RATE:-15}" \
581	            --wait \
582	            >"$logf" 2>&1 &
583	        else
584	          nohup "$bin" start \
585	            --port "$port" \
586	            --rate-limit "${COPILOT_PROXY_RATE:-15}" \
587	            --wait \
588	            >"$logf" 2>&1 &
589	        fi
590	      else
591	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: starting ($pkg) on port $port ..."
592	        # Fork: needs --proxy-env so Node fetch honours HTTPS_PROXY.
593	        if [ "$use_proxy_env" -eq 1 ]; then
594	          nohup env HTTP_PROXY="$http_proxy_url" HTTPS_PROXY="$http_proxy_url" \
595	            http_proxy="$http_proxy_url" https_proxy="$http_proxy_url" \
596	            "$bin" start \
597	            --port "$port" \
598	            --proxy-env \
599	            >"$logf" 2>&1 &
600	        else
601	          nohup "$bin" start \
602	            --port "$port" \
603	            >"$logf" 2>&1 &
604	        fi
605	      fi
606	      srv_pid=$!
607	      printf '%s\n' "$srv_pid" >"$pidf"
608	      # Wait up to ~20s for it to answer.
609	      local i=0
610	      while [ "$i" -lt 20 ]; do
611	        if _copilot_alive; then
612	          if _copilot_shim_enabled; then
613	            _copilot_shim_start && printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: throttle shim up → $(_copilot_shim_base) (→ $(_copilot_base))"
614	          fi
615	          printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: up → $(_copilot_client_base)  (logs: copilot-proxy logs)"
616	          return 0
617	        fi
618	        # Crashed on its own (bad flag, port taken, auth) — don't sit out the
619	        # remaining seconds pretending we're still waiting.
620	        if ! kill -0 "$srv_pid" 2>/dev/null; then
621	          command rm -f -- "$pidf"
622	          printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: server exited during startup — check 'copilot-proxy logs'." >&2
623	          return 1
624	        fi
625	        sleep 1
626	        i=$((i + 1))
627	      done
628	      # Timed out. REAP what we spawned: the old code returned and left it running,
629	      # so each retry stacked another orphan (5 of them, in the wild) and none ever
630	      # bound the port.
631	      kill "$srv_pid" 2>/dev/null
632	      command rm -f -- "$pidf"
633	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: did not come up in time — check 'copilot-proxy logs'." >&2
634	      return 1
635	      ;;
636	    stop)
637	      # Tear down the shim first (harmless if not running).
638	      _copilot_shim_stop
639	      # Prefer the tracked pid; fall back to a broad match.
640	      if [ -f "$pidf" ]; then
641	        local pid; pid="$(cat "$pidf" 2>/dev/null)"
642	        [ -n "$pid" ] && kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null
643	        command rm -f -- "$pidf"
644	      fi
645	      command pkill -f "copilot-api.*--port $port" 2>/dev/null
646	      sleep 1
647	      if _copilot_alive; then
648	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: still answering on $port (another instance?)" >&2
649	        return 1
650	      fi
651	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: stopped (port $port free)"
652	      ;;
653	    restart)
654	      copilot-proxy stop
655	      copilot-proxy start
656	      ;;
657	    status)
658	      if _copilot_alive; then
659	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: RUNNING on $(_copilot_base)"
660	        printf '%s\n' "  models: $(command curl -fsS --max-time 3 "$(_copilot_base)/v1/models" 2>/dev/null \
661	          | command grep -o '"id":"[^"]*"' | command sed 's/"id":"//;s/"//' | command grep -i claude | command tr '\n' ' ')"
662	        if _copilot_shim_enabled; then
663	          if _copilot_shim_alive; then
664	            printf '%s\n' "  shim:   ON, up on $(_copilot_shim_base)  → clients use this"
665	          else
666	            printf '%s\n' "  shim:   ON but DOWN (clients fall back to $(_copilot_base); try 'copilot-proxy shim on')"
667	          fi
668	        else
669	          printf '%s\n' "  shim:   off  (enable: copilot-proxy shim on)"
670	        fi
671	      else
672	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: not running on port $port  (start: copilot-proxy start)"
673	        return 1
674	      fi
675	      ;;
676	    doctor|test)
677	      # Diagnose the whole path: prereqs -> auth -> proxy -> model entitlement
678	      # -> upstream reachability -> (optional) a real inference round-trip.
679	      #
680	      # The model-entitlement check is the one that matters most: a Copilot plan
681	      # that serves no Anthropic models fails EVERY request with a 400
682	      # "model_not_supported", which reads like a network fault in the logs but
683	      # is an account-policy fact no amount of proxy tuning will fix.
684	      local _live=0
685	      case "${2:-}" in --live) _live=1 ;; esac
686	
687	      # Colour only when stdout is a terminal, so `copilot-proxy doctor | tee`
688	      # and CI capture stay readable. printf (not $'..') keeps this sh-portable.
689	      local _g='' _r_='' _y='' _z=''
690	      if [ -t 1 ]; then
691	        _g="$(printf '\033[32m')"; _r_="$(printf '\033[31m')"
692	        _y="$(printf '\033[33m')"; _z="$(printf '\033[0m')"
693	      fi
694	
695	      local _fail=0 _warn=0
696	      _ok()   { printf '  %s✓%s %-16s %s\n' "$_g" "$_z" "$1" "$2"; }
697	      _bad()  { printf '  %s✗%s %-16s %s\n' "$_r_" "$_z" "$1" "$2"; _fail=$((_fail+1)); }
698	      _note() { printf '  %s!%s %-16s %s\n' "$_y" "$_z" "$1" "$2"; _warn=$((_warn+1)); }
699	      _skip() { printf '  · %-16s %s\n' "$1" "$2"; }
700	      _hint() { printf '    %-16s → %s\n' "" "$1"; }
701	
702	      printf '\ncopilot-proxy doctor   port %s   pkg %s\n\n' "$port" "$pkg"
703	
704	      printf '%s\n' "Prerequisites"
705	      local _tool
706	      for _tool in bun curl jq; do
707	        if command -v "$_tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then _ok "$_tool" "$(command -v "$_tool")"
708	        elif [ "$_tool" = jq ]; then _note "$_tool" "not found — some checks degrade to grep"
709	        else _bad "$_tool" "not found"; fi
710	      done
711	
712	      printf '\n%s\n' "Package"
713	      # The proxy runs an INSTALLED binary, not `bunx <pkg>` — so a warm start does
714	      # no network at all. An un-installed prefix is not a fault: the next start
715	      # installs it once.
716	      if _copilot_pkg_ready; then
717	        _ok "installed" "$pkg"
718	        _skip "bin" "$(_copilot_pkg_bin)"
719	      else
720	        _note "not installed" "$pkg — the next 'copilot-proxy start' installs it (one-time)"
721	        _hint "copilot-proxy reinstall   # or force it now"
722	      fi
723	
724	      printf '\n%s\n' "Authentication"
725	      local _tok="$HOME/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token"
726	      if [ -f "$_tok" ]; then _ok "token file" "$_tok"
727	      else _bad "token file" "absent"; _hint "copilot-proxy auth"; fi
728	
729	      printf '\n%s\n' "Proxy"
730	      if _copilot_alive; then _ok "listening" "$(_copilot_base)"
731	      else
732	        _bad "listening" "nothing answering on port $port"
733	        _hint "copilot-proxy start"
734	      fi
735	      # A wedged package installer is the non-obvious reason a proxy never binds
736	      # the port (see _copilot_stale_installers): 'copilot-proxy start' just says
737	      # "did not come up in time" and the log shows only "Resolving dependencies".
738	      # Flag it hard when nothing is listening (this IS the fault), softer when
739	      # the proxy is up (a leftover, but still worth clearing — it holds bun's
740	      # cache lock and will hang the next restart).
741	      local _stale _stale_n
742	      _stale="$(_copilot_stale_installers)"
743	      if [ -n "$_stale" ]; then
744	        _stale_n="$(printf '%s\n' "$_stale" | command grep -c .)"
745	        if _copilot_alive; then
746	          _note "stale installer" "$_stale_n leftover 'bun add … copilot-api' proc(s) — harmless now, but they hold bun's cache lock (a restart will hang)"
747	        else
748	          _bad "stale installer" "$_stale_n wedged 'bun add … copilot-api' proc(s) — start is blocked at \"Resolving dependencies\", never binds port $port"
749	        fi
750	        _hint "pkill -f 'bun add.*copilot-api'; rm -rf \"\$HOME/.bun/install/cache/.tmp\"/*; copilot-proxy start"
751	        _hint "re-hangs? bun is stalling on the socks proxy — env -u ALL_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u HTTP_PROXY copilot-proxy start"
752	      else
753	        _skip "installer" "no wedged 'bun add' process"
754	      fi
755	      if _copilot_shim_enabled; then
756	        if _copilot_shim_alive; then _ok "throttle shim" "up on $(_copilot_shim_base) → clients use this"
757	        else _bad "throttle shim" "enabled but DOWN"; _hint "copilot-proxy shim on"; fi
758	      else
759	        _skip "throttle shim" "off"
760	      fi
761	
762	      printf '\n%s\n' "Models"
763	      local _served _n _claude _model _src _pin
764	      local _http_proxy _up_direct _up_via _dir_n _dir_c _via_n _via_c
765	      _http_proxy="$(_copilot_resolve_http_proxy)"
766	      if [ -n "$_http_proxy" ]; then
767	        _note "http proxy" "$_http_proxy (COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=${COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY:-auto}) — Node needs --proxy-env to use this"
768	      else
769	        _skip "http proxy" "none detected (COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=${COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY:-auto})"
770	      fi
771	
772	      if _served="$(_copilot_served_models)" && [ -n "$_served" ]; then
773	        _n="$(printf '%s\n' "$_served" | command grep -c .)"
774	        _claude="$(printf '%s\n' "$_served" | command grep -ci '^claude' || true)"
775	        _ok "served" "$_n model ids"
776	        if [ "$_claude" -gt 0 ]; then
777	          _ok "claude models" "$_claude ids available"
778	        else
779	          _bad "claude models" "0 of $_n — the proxy is serving no Anthropic models"
780	        fi
781	
782	        # A/B: true-direct vs via local Clash/Verge. GitHub geo-filters the
783	        # Claude catalog on CN egress; curl's default path follows System Proxy
784	        # so a single "upstream" probe used to mis-label that as entitlement.
785	        _dir_c=0; _via_c=0
786	        if _up_direct="$(_copilot_upstream_models direct)" && [ -n "$_up_direct" ]; then
787	          _dir_n="$(printf '%s\n' "$_up_direct" | command grep -c .)"
788	          _dir_c="$(printf '%s\n' "$_up_direct" | command grep -ci '^claude' || true)"
789	          _ok "upstream direct" "$_dir_n ids, $_dir_c claude (--noproxy)"
790	        else
791	          _skip "upstream direct" "could not query GitHub direct (need token + jq, or blocked)"
792	        fi
793	        if [ -n "$_http_proxy" ]; then
794	          if _up_via="$(_copilot_upstream_models "$_http_proxy")" && [ -n "$_up_via" ]; then
795	            _via_n="$(printf '%s\n' "$_up_via" | command grep -c .)"
796	            _via_c="$(printf '%s\n' "$_up_via" | command grep -ci '^claude' || true)"
797	            _ok "upstream via proxy" "$_via_n ids, $_via_c claude ($_http_proxy)"
798	          else
799	            _bad "upstream via proxy" "no response through $_http_proxy"
800	            _hint "Clash/mihomo node may be down — try another PROXY selection"
801	          fi
802	        fi
803	
804	        if [ "$_via_c" -gt 0 ] && [ "$_dir_c" -eq 0 ]; then
805	          _note "egress geo" "Claude appears ONLY via local proxy — GitHub filters Anthropic on direct/CN egress"
806	          if [ "$_claude" -eq 0 ]; then
807	            _bad "MISSING --proxy-env" "copilot-api started without HTTPS_PROXY, so it cached the direct (no-Claude) catalog"
808	            _hint "copilot-proxy restart   # auto uses --proxy-env when a local proxy is detected"
809	            _hint "or: COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7897 copilot-proxy restart"
810	          fi
811	        elif [ "$_via_c" -eq 0 ] && [ "$_dir_c" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "${_up_direct}${_up_via}" ]; then
812	          _note "entitlement" "neither direct nor via-proxy catalogs include Claude"
813	          _hint "org Copilot policy may disable Anthropic — a restart will NOT help"
814	        elif [ "$_claude" -eq 0 ] && [ "$_via_c" -gt 0 ]; then
815	          _bad "STALE CACHE" "via-proxy upstream has Claude but the running process does not"
816	          _hint "copilot-proxy restart"
817	        elif [ "$_claude" -gt 0 ]; then
818	          _ok "cache" "served Claude list looks healthy"
819	        fi
820	
821	        _pin="$(_copilot_effective_model)"
822	        _model="${_pin%%|*}"; _src="${_pin##*|}"
823	        if printf '%s\n' "$_served" | command grep -qxF "$_model"; then
824	          _ok "pinned model" "$_model  ($_src)"
825	        else
826	          _bad "pinned model" "$_model  ($_src)"
827	          _hint "not in the served list → every request returns 400 model_not_supported"
828	          _hint "copilot-model --auto   # Claude > Codex > GPT > Gemini from served list"
829	          _hint "copilot-model -l       # list served ids"
830	        fi
831	      else
832	        _bad "served" "could not fetch $(_copilot_base)/v1/models"
833	        # Still run the A/B so a stopped proxy doesn't hide the geo diagnosis.
834	        if _up_direct="$(_copilot_upstream_models direct)" && [ -n "$_up_direct" ]; then
835	          _dir_c="$(printf '%s\n' "$_up_direct" | command grep -ci '^claude' || true)"
836	          _ok "upstream direct" "$(printf '%s\n' "$_up_direct" | command grep -c .) ids, $_dir_c claude"
837	        fi
838	        if [ -n "$_http_proxy" ] && _up_via="$(_copilot_upstream_models "$_http_proxy")" && [ -n "$_up_via" ]; then
839	          _via_c="$(printf '%s\n' "$_up_via" | command grep -ci '^claude' || true)"
840	          _ok "upstream via proxy" "$(printf '%s\n' "$_up_via" | command grep -c .) ids, $_via_c claude"
841	          if [ "$_via_c" -gt 0 ]; then
842	            _hint "start with proxy: copilot-proxy start   # will attach --proxy-env automatically"
843	          fi
844	        fi
845	      fi
846	
847	      printf '\n%s\n' "Upstream (GitHub Copilot API)"
848	      local _sysproxy _r _code _t
849	      _sysproxy="$(_copilot_system_proxy)"
850	      for _h in api.enterprise.githubcopilot.com api.githubcopilot.com; do
851	        if _r="$(_copilot_probe "https://$_h/models")"; then
852	          _code="${_r%%|*}"; _t="${_r##*|}"
853	          _ok "$_h" "direct HTTP $_code in ${_t}s"
854	        else
855	          _bad "$_h" "direct — no response within 12s"
856	          _hint "connection blocked or upstream unreachable without a proxy"
857	        fi
858	        if [ -n "$_sysproxy" ]; then
859	          if _r="$(_copilot_probe "https://$_h/models" "http://$_sysproxy")"; then
860	            _code="${_r%%|*}"; _t="${_r##*|}"
861	            _ok "$_h" "via $_sysproxy HTTP $_code in ${_t}s"
862	          else
863	            _bad "$_h" "via $_sysproxy — no response within 12s"
864	            _hint "your system proxy cannot reach this host; bypass it or fix the rule"
865	          fi
866	        fi
867	      done
868	      _skip "" "HTTP 400/401 = reached (an unauthenticated probe is expected to be rejected)"
869	
870	      printf '\n%s\n' "Network / local proxy"
871	      if [ -n "$_sysproxy" ]; then
872	        _note "system proxy" "$_sysproxy (macOS HTTP+HTTPS)"
873	        local _ph="${_sysproxy%%:*}" _pp="${_sysproxy##*:}"
874	        if command nc -z -G 2 "$_ph" "$_pp" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
875	          _ok "proxy port" "$_sysproxy is listening"
876	        else
877	          _bad "proxy port" "$_sysproxy is NOT listening — system proxy points at a dead port"
878	          _hint "start Clash/mihomo, or turn the macOS system proxy off"
879	        fi
880	      else
881	        _skip "system proxy" "disabled"
882	      fi
883	      if command pgrep -f -i 'clash|mihomo' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
884	        _note "clash/mihomo" "running — long streaming POSTs can be dropped by a flaky node"
885	        _hint "an ETIMEDOUT mid-request (not at connect) usually means the proxy node died"
886	      else
887	        _skip "clash/mihomo" "not running"
888	      fi
889	      if [ -n "${HTTPS_PROXY:-${https_proxy:-}}" ]; then
890	        _note "env proxy" "HTTPS_PROXY is set — bun/node honour this (and --proxy-env), the macOS System Proxy alone they ignore"
891	      else
892	        _skip "env proxy" "HTTPS_PROXY unset in this shell (copilot-proxy start auto-injects it when a local proxy is detected)"
893	      fi
894	
895	      printf '\n%s\n' "Live probe"
896	      if [ "$_live" -ne 1 ]; then
897	        _skip "skipped" "pass --live to send one real request (consumes 1 quota unit)"
898	      elif ! _copilot_alive; then
899	        _skip "skipped" "proxy is not running"
900	      elif [ -z "${_served:-}" ]; then
901	        _skip "skipped" "no served model to probe with"
902	      else
903	        # Pick a chat model, never an embedding one, and never a "[1m]" alias:
904	        # that suffix is Claude Code-only sugar and the proxy rejects it from a
905	        # raw API client (see _copilot_default_model's notes).
906	        local _probe_model _body
907	        _probe_model="$(printf '%s\n' "$_served" \
908	          | command grep -vi 'embedding' | command grep -v '\[1m\]' | command head -n 1)"
909	        _body="$(printf '{"model":"%s","max_tokens":1,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}' "$_probe_model")"
910	        # Probe the base CLIENTS use (the shim when it's up), so the live check
911	        # exercises the same chain Claude Code does.
912	        if _r="$(command curl -o /dev/null -s -w '%{http_code}|%{time_total}' --max-time 60 \
913	                   -X POST "$(_copilot_client_base)/v1/messages?beta=true" \
914	                   -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "$_body" 2>/dev/null)"; then
915	          _code="${_r%%|*}"; _t="${_r##*|}"
916	          case "$_code" in
917	            2*) _ok "round-trip" "$_probe_model → HTTP $_code in ${_t}s" ;;
918	            000) _bad "round-trip" "$_probe_model → no response (timeout/reset)"
919	                 _hint "this is the streaming-fault class; suspect the local proxy chain" ;;
920	            *)  _bad "round-trip" "$_probe_model → HTTP $_code in ${_t}s"
921	                _hint "copilot-proxy logs 40" ;;
922	          esac
923	        else
924	          _bad "round-trip" "request failed outright"
925	        fi
926	      fi
927	
928	      printf '\n'
929	      if [ "$_fail" -gt 0 ]; then
930	        printf '%s\n\n' "$_fail failed, $_warn warning(s)"
931	        unset -f _ok _bad _note _skip _hint 2>/dev/null
932	        return 1
933	      fi
934	      printf '%s\n\n' "all checks passed ($_warn warning(s))"
935	      unset -f _ok _bad _note _skip _hint 2>/dev/null
936	      ;;
937	    logs)
938	      # logs [N] [gen]  — tail the fork log; gen 1..3 = a rotated prev session.
939	      # logs shim [N]    — tail the throttle shim's log instead.
940	      local _lf _n
941	      if [ "${2:-}" = "shim" ]; then
942	        _lf="$(_copilot_shim_logfile)"; _n="${3:-40}"
943	      else
944	        _lf="$logf"; _n="${2:-40}"
945	        case "${3:-}" in 1|2|3) _lf="$logf.$3" ;; esac
946	      fi
947	      if [ -f "$_lf" ]; then command tail -n "$_n" "$_lf"; else
948	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: no log file at $_lf" >&2; return 1; fi
949	      ;;
950	    auth)
951	      # One-time device login → stores a ghu_ token copilot-api can exchange.
952	      _copilot_ensure_pkg || return 1
953	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: launching copilot-api device login ..."
954	      "$(_copilot_pkg_bin)" auth
955	      ;;
956	    reinstall)
957	      # Force a clean re-install of the pinned spec (normally only needed if the
958	      # prefix got corrupted — a version bump re-installs on its own via the stamp).
959	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: removing $(_copilot_pkg_prefix) ..."
960	      command rm -rf -- "$(_copilot_pkg_prefix)"
961	      _copilot_ensure_pkg || return 1
962	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: installed $(_copilot_pkg) → $(_copilot_pkg_bin)"
963	      ;;
964	    whoami|usage)
965	      # Real login check: exchanges the stored token against GitHub and prints
966	      # the account / plan / quota. Fails loudly if the token is missing/expired.
967	      if [ ! -f "$HOME/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token" ]; then
968	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: not authenticated — run 'copilot-proxy auth' first." >&2
969	        return 1
970	      fi
971	      if [ "$(_copilot_pkg_flavor)" = "original" ]; then
972	        _copilot_ensure_pkg || return 1
973	        "$(_copilot_pkg_bin)" check-usage
974	      elif _copilot_alive; then
975	        # Fork has no check-usage subcommand; its /usage endpoint serves the
976	        # GitHub quota payload (same data as the bundled /usage-viewer).
977	        if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
978	          command curl -fsS --max-time 5 "$(_copilot_base)/usage" | jq '{
979	            plan: (.copilot_plan // .access_type_sku // "unknown"),
980	            quota_reset: (.quota_reset_date // null),
981	            quotas: ((.quota_snapshots // {}) | map_values(
982	              if type == "object" then
983	                {remaining, entitlement, percent_remaining, unlimited}
984	              else . end))
985	          }'
986	        else
987	          command curl -fsS --max-time 5 "$(_copilot_base)/usage"
988	        fi
989	      else
990	        # Proxy down → the fork's `debug` still validates auth state / paths.
991	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: not running — showing auth/debug info instead of quota." >&2
992	        _copilot_ensure_pkg || return 1
993	        "$(_copilot_pkg_bin)" debug
994	      fi
995	      ;;
996	    shim)
997	      # shim [on|off|status] — persist the toggle, and start/stop it live if the
998	      # fork is already running.
999	      local sf; sf="$(_copilot_shim_state)"
1000	      case "${2:-status}" in
1001	        on)
1002	          command mkdir -p "$(command dirname "$sf")"; printf 'on\n' >"$sf"
1003	          if _copilot_alive; then
1004	            _copilot_shim_start && printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim ON → $(_copilot_shim_base) (→ $(_copilot_base))"
1005	          else
1006	            printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim enabled; will start with the proxy ('copilot-proxy start')."
1007	          fi
1008	          printf '%s\n' "  NOTE: restart Claude Code so it picks up ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=$(_copilot_shim_base)"
1009	          ;;
1010	        off)
1011	          printf 'off\n' >"$sf"; _copilot_shim_stop
1012	          printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim OFF (clients use $(_copilot_base) directly)"
1013	          printf '%s\n' "  NOTE: restart Claude Code to point back at $(_copilot_base)"
1014	          ;;
1015	        status|*)
1016	          if _copilot_shim_enabled; then
1017	            printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim ON ($(_copilot_shim_alive && echo up || echo down)) on $(_copilot_shim_base)"
1018	          else
1019	            printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: shim off"
1020	          fi
1021	          ;;
1022	      esac
1023	      ;;
1024	    -h|--help|help)
1025	      printf '%s\n' "Usage: copilot-proxy [start|stop|restart|status|doctor [--live]|logs [shim|N [gen]]|shim [on|off|status]|whoami|auth|reinstall]"
1026	      printf '%s\n' "  doctor (alias: test)  diagnose prereqs, auth, proxy, Claude catalog (direct vs via"
1027	      printf '%s\n' "                        Clash), upstream reachability. --live costs 1 quota unit."
1028	      printf '%s\n' "  COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY    auto|always|never|http://127.0.0.1:PORT  (default auto)"
1029	      printf '%s\n' "                        auto attaches --proxy-env when proxy-status finds a local proxy."
1030	      printf '%s\n' "  reinstall             wipe + re-install the pinned package (a version bump"
1031	      printf '%s\n' "                        re-installs on its own; this is for a corrupted prefix)."
1032	      ;;
1033	    *)
1034	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: unknown action '$action' (try --help)" >&2
1035	      return 1
1036	      ;;
1037	  esac
1038	}
1039	
1040	# --- session wrapper (Layer 1: one-off, zero file writes) ------------------------
1041	
1042	# Run any command with the copilot-proxy env injected (per-process only —
1043	# nothing is written to disk). Auto-starts the proxy when it isn't answering.
1044	# GOTCHA (verified 2026-07): current Claude Code lets the settings.local.json
1045	# env block beat inherited shell env, so this does NOT win inside a project
1046	# where `copilot-here on` pins something else — `copilot-here off` first.
1047	# Example:
1048	#   copilot-run claude                      # raw Claude Code on the proxy
1049	#   copilot-run specstory run claude        # specstory-wrapped session
1050	copilot-run() {
1051	  if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
1052	    printf '%s\n' "Usage: copilot-run <cmd> [args...]   (injects ANTHROPIC_* proxy env)" >&2
1053	    return 1
1054	  fi
1055	  if ! _copilot_alive; then
1056	    copilot-proxy start || return 1
1057	  fi
1058	  # If the shim is enabled but not up (e.g. toggled on after the proxy started),
1059	  # bring it up now so ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL below resolves to it.
1060	  if _copilot_shim_enabled && ! _copilot_shim_alive; then _copilot_shim_start; fi
1061	  local model; model="$(_copilot_default_model)"
1062	  # Opt-in quota savers (COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET=1): prepended as NAME=VALUE args
1063	  # to `env`. Off by default — they degrade the Claude Code UX a little.
1064	  if [ "${COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET:-0}" = "1" ]; then
1065	    set -- \
1066	      CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER="0" \
1067	      CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION="false" \
1068	      CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY="0" \
1069	      DISABLE_NON_ESSENTIAL_MODEL_CALLS="1" \
1070	      "$@"
1071	  fi
1072	  # `command env` (not bare var-prefix) so the vars are strictly per-process:
1073	  # POSIX var-prefix on a *function* call would leak into the current shell.
1074	  command env \
1075	    ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="$(_copilot_client_base)" \
1076	    ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="dummy" \
1077	    ANTHROPIC_MODEL="$model" \
1078	    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL="$model" \
1079	    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL="claude-sonnet-5[1m]" \
1080	    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL="claude-haiku-4-5" \
1081	    ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL="claude-haiku-4-5" \
1082	    CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC="1" \
1083	    "$@"
1084	}
1085	
1086	# --- specstory `-c` passthrough (why the base command must come from config) ----
1087	#
1088	# specstory's `-c/--command` REPLACES the provider's configured command — it does
1089	# NOT append to it. The shipped config says as much: "Use of these is equivalent
1090	# to -c \"custom command\"" — same slot, last write wins. So a hardcoded
1091	# `-c "claude $*"` silently drops every flag in `claude_cmd` the moment
1092	# claude-copilot has args to pass through.
1093	#
1094	# Symptom that found this (verified 2026-07, specstory 2.5.0): with
1095	# `claude_cmd = "claude --dangerously-skip-permissions"` in the specstory config,
1096	# a bare `claude-copilot-once` took the no-`-c` branch and correctly ran in
1097	# bypass-permissions mode, but `claude-copilot-once --resume X` took the `-c`
1098	# branch and fell back to ~/.claude/settings.json's permissions.defaultMode
1099	# ("auto"). Same wrapper, opposite permission mode, no warning either way.
1100	#
1101	# Deriving the base command from the config keeps specstory the single source of
1102	# truth for BOTH branches: change `claude_cmd` there and both paths follow.
1103	# `--no-specstory` deliberately does NOT inherit it (opting out of specstory
1104	# means opting out of its config too).
1105	
1106	# Effective `claude_cmd`, honouring specstory's own precedence:
1107	#   project ./.specstory/cli/config.toml > user ~/.specstory/cli/config.toml
1108	#   > bare `claude`
1109	# Matches UNCOMMENTED assignments only — both shipped configs carry a commented
1110	# `# claude_cmd = "claude"` example, and matching that would re-introduce the very
1111	# bug this exists to fix. Handles TOML's double- and single-quoted strings.
1112	_copilot_specstory_claude_cmd() {
1113	  local f cmd=''
1114	  for f in ".specstory/cli/config.toml" "$HOME/.specstory/cli/config.toml"; do
1115	    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
1116	    cmd="$(command sed -n \
1117	      -e "s/^[[:space:]]*claude_cmd[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p" \
1118	      -e "s/^[[:space:]]*claude_cmd[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*'\([^']*\)'.*/\1/p" \
1119	      "$f" 2>/dev/null | command head -n 1)"
1120	    if [ -n "$cmd" ]; then break; fi
1121	  done
1122	  printf '%s' "${cmd:-claude}"
1123	}
1124	
1125	# Single-quote ONE argument for embedding in specstory's `-c` command STRING.
1126	# specstory shell-splits that string honouring quotes (verified: `-p 'a b'`
1127	# arrives as a single argv entry), so quoting is both possible and necessary —
1128	# the old `"claude $*"` flattened `claude-copilot -p "two words"` into two
1129	# separate arguments. POSIX escape for an embedded quote: close, \', reopen.
1130	_copilot_shquote() {
1131	  printf "'%s'" "$(printf '%s' "${1:-}" | command sed "s/'/'\\\\''/g")"
1132	}
1133	
1134	# One-off Claude Code session backed by the Copilot proxy. Nothing on disk
1135	# changes — revert is just running plain `claude` next time.
1136	# Wraps in `specstory run` when specstory is installed (markdown auto-save,
1137	# same convention as scode/svibe); opt out with --no-specstory. Extra args go
1138	# to the claude CLI via specstory's -c "custom command" passthrough, appended to
1139	# the configured `claude_cmd` (see the block above — `-c` REPLACES that command,
1140	# so we have to rebuild it or its flags are lost).
1141	# Example:
1142	#   claude-copilot                 # specstory run claude (proxy env)
1143	#   claude-copilot -c              # continue last session
1144	#   claude-copilot --no-specstory  # raw claude, no markdown auto-save
1145	claude-copilot() {
1146	  local ss="auto"
1147	  case "${1:-}" in
1148	    --no-specstory) ss="never"; shift ;;
1149	    --specstory)    shift ;;
1150	    -h|--help)
1151	      printf '%s\n' "Usage: claude-copilot [--no-specstory] [claude args...]"
1152	      printf '%s\n' "  One-off Claude Code session on the Copilot proxy (no file writes)."
1153	      printf '%s\n' "  Sticky per-project instead: copilot-here on"
1154	      return 0 ;;
1155	  esac
1156	  if [ "$ss" = "auto" ] && command -v specstory >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1157	    if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then
1158	      # Rebuild what `-c` clobbers: the configured base command (ITS flags left
1159	      # unquoted so specstory splits them normally) + each of our args quoted.
1160	      local _cc_cmd _cc_arg
1161	      _cc_cmd="$(_copilot_specstory_claude_cmd)"
1162	      for _cc_arg in "$@"; do
1163	        _cc_cmd="$_cc_cmd $(_copilot_shquote "$_cc_arg")"
1164	      done
1165	      copilot-run specstory run claude -c "$_cc_cmd"
1166	    else
1167	      copilot-run specstory run claude
1168	    fi
1169	  else
1170	    copilot-run claude "$@"
1171	  fi
1172	}
1173	
1174	# --- per-project toggle (Layer 2: sticky, gitignored settings.local.json) --------
1175	
1176	# Env keys we own in .claude/settings.local.json (kept in one place so `off`
1177	# removes exactly what `on` added — including the COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET extras,
1178	# regardless of the knob's value at `off` time).
1179	_copilot_here_keys='["ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL","ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN","ANTHROPIC_MODEL","ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL","ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL","ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL","ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL","CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC","CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER","CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION","CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY","DISABLE_NON_ESSENTIAL_MODEL_CALLS"]'
1180	
1181	# The EXACT env object `copilot-here on` would write right now, as JSON.
1182	#
1183	# SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for both `copilot-here on` (what it merges in) and
1184	# _copilot_here_drift (what it compares against). These were two hand-maintained
1185	# copies and they had already diverged: `on` wrote 8 keys while the drift check
1186	# compared only 4, so a pin written by an older `on` — current models but no
1187	# ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL / ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL /
1188	# CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC — reported "no drift" while `on`
1189	# would still have changed it. Add a key here and BOTH sides follow.
1190	#
1191	# Needs jq; every caller already requires it.
1192	_copilot_env_json() {
1193	  jq -n \
1194	    --arg base_url "$(_copilot_pinned_base)" \
1195	    --arg model "$(_copilot_default_model)" \
1196	    --arg quiet "${COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET:-0}" '
1197	    {
1198	      ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: $base_url,
1199	      ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN: "dummy",
1200	      ANTHROPIC_MODEL: $model,
1201	      ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL: $model,
1202	      ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL: "claude-sonnet-5[1m]",
1203	      ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL: "claude-haiku-4-5",
1204	      ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL: "claude-haiku-4-5",
1205	      CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC: "1"
1206	    } + (if $quiet == "1" then {
1207	      CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER: "0",
1208	      CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION: "false",
1209	      CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY: "0",
1210	      DISABLE_NON_ESSENTIAL_MODEL_CALLS: "1"
1211	    } else {} end)'
1212	}
1213	
1214	# Pin THIS project to the Copilot proxy via ./.claude/settings.local.json —
1215	# the gitignored local layer that overrides the committed .claude/settings.json
1216	# (so claude-plans-here's plansDirectory stays untouched). Plain `claude` then
1217	# uses the proxy here until `copilot-here off`.
1218	# Example:
1219	#   copilot-here on        # pin project to the proxy
1220	#   copilot-here status    # pinned? which model?
1221	#   copilot-here off       # unpin (removes only our env keys)
1222	copilot-here() {
1223	  if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1224	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: jq is required" >&2; return 1
1225	  fi
1226	
1227	  local settings=".claude/settings.local.json"
1228	  local action="${1:-status}"
1229	  case "$action" in
1230	    on)
1231	      command mkdir -p .claude
1232	      local base='{}'
1233	      [ -f "$settings" ] && base="$(command cat "$settings")"
1234	      [ -n "$base" ] || base='{}'
1235	      local model; model="$(_copilot_default_model)"
1236	      local tmp; tmp="$(command mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-here.XXXXXX")" || return 1
1237	      if printf '%s' "$base" | jq --argjson want "$(_copilot_env_json)" \
1238	          '.env = ((.env // {}) + $want)' >"$tmp"; then
1239	        command mv -- "$tmp" "$settings"
1240	      else
1241	        command rm -f -- "$tmp"
1242	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: jq failed; $settings unchanged" >&2
1243	        return 1
1244	      fi
1245	      # Claude Code only auto-gitignores settings.local.json when IT creates the
1246	      # file — since we created it, belt-and-braces via .git/info/exclude (a
1247	      # per-clone, never-committed ignore, so the proxy toggle leaves nothing to
1248	      # commit — unlike Claude Code's own root-.gitignore entry).
1249	      if command git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1250	        if ! command git check-ignore -q "$settings" 2>/dev/null; then
1251	          local exclude; exclude="$(command git rev-parse --git-dir)/info/exclude"
1252	          # MUST be the un-anchored **/ form, NOT a bare .claude/settings.local.json:
1253	          # a pattern with an internal slash is anchored to the repo ROOT, so it
1254	          # would not ignore the file when THIS project lives in a subdirectory of
1255	          # a larger repo (e.g. skills/foo/.claude/…). **/ matches at any depth —
1256	          # one idempotent line covers root + every nested project.
1257	          printf '%s\n' "**/.claude/settings.local.json" >>"$exclude"
1258	        fi
1259	      fi
1260	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: ON — $settings pins Claude Code to $(_copilot_base) (model: $model)"
1261	      printf '%s\n' "  plain \`claude\` in this project now uses the proxy (restart any running session)"
1262	      _copilot_alive || printf '%s\n' "  ⚠ proxy not running — start it with: copilot-proxy start"
1263	      ;;
1264	    off)
1265	      if [ ! -f "$settings" ]; then
1266	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: already off (no $settings)"
1267	        return 0
1268	      fi
1269	      local tmp; tmp="$(command mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-here.XXXXXX")" || return 1
1270	      # Remove only OUR env keys; drop .env when it empties; keep other content.
1271	      if jq --argjson keys "$_copilot_here_keys" '
1272	          .env = ((.env // {}) | with_entries(select(.key as $k | ($keys | index($k)) == null)))
1273	          | if .env == {} then del(.env) else . end' \
1274	          "$settings" >"$tmp"; then
1275	        if [ "$(jq -r 'if . == {} then "empty" else "kept" end' "$tmp")" = "empty" ]; then
1276	          command rm -f -- "$tmp" "$settings"
1277	          printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: OFF — removed $settings (it held only proxy config)"
1278	        else
1279	          command mv -- "$tmp" "$settings"
1280	          printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: OFF — proxy env removed from $settings (other content kept)"
1281	        fi
1282	        printf '%s\n' "  plain \`claude\` is back on the real Anthropic backend (restart any running session)"
1283	      else
1284	        command rm -f -- "$tmp"
1285	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: jq failed; $settings unchanged" >&2
1286	        return 1
1287	      fi
1288	      ;;
1289	    status)
1290	      if [ -f "$settings" ] && [ "$(jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL // empty' "$settings" 2>/dev/null)" != "" ]; then
1291	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: ON  (base: $(jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL' "$settings"), model: $(jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL // "(unset)"' "$settings"))"
1292	        local _drift; _drift="$(_copilot_here_drift)"
1293	        [ -n "$_drift" ] && { printf '%s\n' "  ⚠ stale vs current defaults:"; printf '%s\n' "$_drift"; printf '%s\n' "  refresh in place: copilot-here on"; }
1294	        _copilot_alive || printf '%s\n' "  ⚠ proxy not running — start it with: copilot-proxy start"
1295	      else
1296	        printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: off  (enable: copilot-here on; one-off: claude-copilot)"
1297	        return 1
1298	      fi
1299	      ;;
1300	    -h|--help|help)
1301	      printf '%s\n' "Usage: copilot-here [on|off|status]   (toggles ./.claude/settings.local.json)"
1302	      ;;
1303	    *)
1304	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-here: unknown action '$action' (try --help)" >&2
1305	      return 1
1306	      ;;
1307	  esac
1308	}
1309	
1310	# --- one-shot pinned session (Layer 2, auto-reverted) ---------------------------
1311	
1312	# Combine copilot-here (settings.local.json pin — beats inherited env, see Gotchas)
1313	# with claude-copilot's ephemerality: pin THIS project, run ONE specstory-wrapped
1314	# session, then unpin — even on Ctrl-C / kill. The proxy must already be up (we only
1315	# notify; start it with `copilot-proxy start`). If copilot-here is already ON here,
1316	# the existing pin is left untouched on exit (safe to run inside a pinned project).
1317	# Example:
1318	#   claude-copilot-once                 # pin, run, auto-unpin
1319	#   claude-copilot-once -c              # continue last session
1320	#   claude-copilot-once --no-specstory  # raw claude, no markdown auto-save
1321	claude-copilot-once() {
1322	  case "${1:-}" in
1323	    -h|--help)
1324	      printf '%s\n' "Usage: claude-copilot-once [--no-specstory] [claude args...]"
1325	      printf '%s\n' "  Pin THIS project to the proxy (copilot-here on), run one Claude Code"
1326	      printf '%s\n' "  session, then auto-unpin (copilot-here off) — even on Ctrl-C."
1327	      printf '%s\n' "  Needs the proxy already running:  copilot-proxy start"
1328	      return 0 ;;
1329	  esac
1330	
1331	  # 1. Proxy must already be answering — notify only, never auto-start.
1332	  if ! _copilot_alive; then
1333	    printf '%s\n' "claude-copilot-once: proxy not reachable on port $(_copilot_port)." >&2
1334	    printf '%s\n' "  start it first:  copilot-proxy start" >&2
1335	    return 1
```

```text
1390	# Internal: INT/TERM/HUP handler — unpin, clear trap, re-raise INT so the

1393	_copilot_once_trap() {
1394	  copilot-here off >/dev/null 2>&1

1401	
1402	# POSIX y/N prompt. Returns 0 only on an explicit yes; a non-interactive stdin
1403	# (no TTY) returns 1 — the safe default (keep, don't override). We only call this
1404	# right before launching an interactive Claude Code session, so reading stdin is
1405	# fine. NOT `read -q` (zsh-only) — this file is sourced by bash too.
1406	_copilot_confirm() {
1407	  local _ans
1408	  [ -t 0 ] || return 1
1409	  printf '%s ' "${1:-Proceed? [y/N]}" >&2
1410	  IFS= read -r _ans || return 1
1411	  case "$_ans" in
1412	    [yY]|[yY][eE][sS]) return 0 ;;
1413	    *) return 1 ;;
1414	  esac
1415	}

1417	# Has THIS project's copilot-here pin drifted from what `copilot-here on` would
1418	# write now (default model bumped, proxy port/shim moved, a key added since the
1419	# pin was written)? Prints one "KEY : old -> new" line per drifted key to stdout;
1420	# exit 0 = stale (drift printed), 1 = up-to-date or not pinned. `copilot-here on`
1421	# re-merges exactly these keys, so refreshing a stale pin is just running it again.
1422	#
1423	# Drift is defined as "the set of keys `copilot-here on` would actually CHANGE",
1424	# computed by diffing the live file against _copilot_env_json — not a hand-picked
1425	# subset (that is how three keys silently went unchecked). Note the asymmetry is
1426	# deliberate: keys present in the file but absent from the want-set are NOT drift,
1427	# because `on` merges and never removes them (only `off` does).
1428	_copilot_here_drift() {
1429	  local settings=".claude/settings.local.json"
1430	  [ -f "$settings" ] || return 1
1431	  command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
1432	  # ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is only set while the pin is ON — absent → nothing to do.
1433	  [ -n "$(jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL // empty' "$settings" 2>/dev/null)" ] || return 1
1434	  local want out
1435	  want="$(_copilot_env_json)" || return 1
1436	  out="$(jq -r --argjson want "$want" '
1437	    (.env // {}) as $cur
1438	    | [ $want
1439	        | to_entries[]
1440	        | select($cur[.key] != .value)
1441	        | "  \(.key) : \($cur[.key] // "(unset)") -> \(.value)" ]
1442	    | .[]' "$settings" 2>/dev/null)"
1443	  [ -n "$out" ] || return 1
1444	  printf '%s\n' "$out"
1445	  return 0
1446	}

1450	# Pick the best served model for Claude Code / copilot-run.
1451	# Preference (first match wins): Claude (known ids, else any claude-*) →
1452	# *codex* → non-mini gpt-5* → any gpt-* → non-flash gemini → any gemini → last resort.
1453	# Appends [1m] for Claude ids known to expose a 1M window to Claude Code.
1454	# Reads newline-separated raw proxy ids on stdin; prints one id (may include [1m]).
1455	_copilot_pick_best_model() {
1456	  local models preferred c
1457	  models="$(command cat)"
1458	  [ -n "$models" ] || return 1
1459	
1460	  for preferred in \
1461	    claude-opus-5 claude-opus-4-8 claude-opus-4-7 claude-opus-4-6 \
1462	    claude-sonnet-5 claude-sonnet-4-6 claude-sonnet-4-5 \
1463	    claude-opus-4-5 claude-haiku-4-5

1465	    if printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -qxF "$preferred"; then
1466	      case "$preferred" in
1467	        claude-opus-5|claude-opus-4-8|claude-sonnet-5) printf '%s[1m]' "$preferred" ;;
1468	        *) printf '%s' "$preferred" ;;
1469	      esac
1470	      return 0
1471	    fi
1472	  done
1473	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^claude-' | command sort -V | command tail -1)"
1474	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1475	
1476	  # Codex family first when Anthropic is geo-/policy-filtered out of the catalog.
1477	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -iE 'codex' | command sort -V | command tail -1)"
1478	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1479	
1480	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^gpt-5' | command grep -vE 'mini|nano' \
1481	        | command sort -V | command tail -1)"
1482	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1483	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^gpt-' | command sort -V | command tail -1)"
1484	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1485	
1486	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^gemini-' | command grep -viE 'flash' \
1487	        | command sort -V | command tail -1)"
1488	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1489	  c="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | command grep -E '^gemini-' | command sort -V | command tail -1)"
1490	  if [ -n "$c" ]; then printf '%s' "$c"; return 0; fi
1491	
1492	  printf '%s\n' "$models" | command sort -V | command tail -1
1493	}

1495	# Switch which Copilot model is pinned. Claude Code's own /model picker sends
1496	# dated Anthropic ids the Copilot backend rejects (model_not_supported), so pin
1497	# here. Use the HYPHENATED ids the proxy lists (claude-opus-4-8); an optional
1498	# "[1m]" suffix tells Claude Code the model has a 1M context window (see
1499	# _copilot_default_model) — it is stripped before validating against the proxy.
1500	#
1501	# Write target (never the committed .claude/settings.json):
1502	#   - copilot-here is ON in this project → ./.claude/settings.local.json
1503	#   - otherwise → global state file (~/.local/state/copilot-proxy/model), which
1504	#     claude-copilot / copilot-run / the next `copilot-here on` pick up.
1505	# Example:
1506	#   copilot-model opus-5           # fuzzy → claude-opus-5 (the default; opus-4-8 etc. work too)
1507	#   copilot-model 'opus-5[1m]'     # same + 1M-context hint for Claude Code
1508	#   copilot-model --auto           # Claude > Codex > GPT > Gemini from live served list
1509	#   copilot-model -l               # list available (live from proxy)
1510	#   copilot-model -c               # print current (+ where it came from)
1511	copilot-model() {
1512	  if [ -n "$ZSH_VERSION" ]; then
1513	    emulate -L zsh
1514	    setopt localoptions pipefail
1515	  else
1516	    set -o pipefail
1517	  fi
1518	
1519	  local settings=".claude/settings.local.json"
1520	  local statef; statef="$(_copilot_model_state)"
1521	
1522	  # copilot-here mode? (local settings file carries our proxy env)
1523	  local target="state"
1524	  if [ -f "$settings" ] && command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 \
1525	     && [ "$(jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL // empty' "$settings" 2>/dev/null)" != "" ]; then
1526	    target="local"
1527	  fi
1528	
1529	  # List available model ids (live proxy, else a static Claude fallback).
1530	  _copilot_model_list() {
1531	    local json
1532	    if json="$(command curl -fsS --max-time 3 "$(_copilot_base)/v1/models" 2>/dev/null)"; then
1533	      printf '%s\n' "$json" | command grep -o '"id":"[^"]*"' | command sed 's/"id":"//;s/"//' | command sort
1534	    else
1535	      printf '%s\n' \
1536	        claude-opus-5 claude-opus-4-8 claude-opus-4-7 claude-opus-4-6 claude-opus-4-5 \
1537	        claude-sonnet-5 claude-sonnet-4-6 claude-sonnet-4-5 claude-haiku-4-5

1541	
1542	  # Current pinned model, from whichever layer is active.
1543	  _copilot_model_current() {

1545	      jq -r '.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL // "(unset)"' "$settings"
1546	    else
1547	      _copilot_default_model
1548	    fi
1549	  }
1550	
1551	  local arg="${1:-}"
1552	  case "$arg" in
1553	    -l|--list) _copilot_model_list; return 0 ;;
1554	    -c|--current)
1555	      if [ "$target" = "local" ]; then
1556	        printf '%s  (project: %s)\n' "$(_copilot_model_current)" "$settings"
1557	      else
1558	        printf '%s  (global: %s)\n' "$(_copilot_model_current)" "$statef"
1559	      fi
1560	      return 0 ;;
1561	    -h|--help)
1562	      printf '%s\n' "Usage: copilot-model [<model-id>|-l|-c|--auto]"
1563	      printf '%s\n' "  --auto  pick best from live served list: Claude > Codex > GPT > Gemini"
1564	      printf '%s\n' "  Writes ./.claude/settings.local.json when copilot-here is on,"
1565	      printf '%s\n' "  else the global state file used by claude-copilot / copilot-run."
1566	      return 0 ;;
1567	  esac
1568	
1569	  if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
1570	    printf '%s\n' "copilot-model: jq is required" >&2; return 1
1571	  fi
1572	
1573	  local models want resolved
1574	  models="$(_copilot_model_list 2>/dev/null)"
1575	
1576	  # --auto: Claude > Codex > GPT > Gemini from the live served catalog.
1577	  # Use when a sticky pin (e.g. gemini from a Claude-less geo day) is stale, or
1578	  # when Anthropic is filtered out and you want the best Codex/GPT instead.
1579	  if [ "$arg" = "--auto" ] || [ "$arg" = "-a" ]; then
1580	    if [ -z "$models" ]; then
1581	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-model: --auto needs a reachable proxy (or static fallback list empty)" >&2
1582	      return 1
1583	    fi
1584	    resolved="$(printf '%s\n' "$models" | _copilot_pick_best_model)" || {
1585	      printf '%s\n' "copilot-model: --auto could not pick a model" >&2
1586	      return 1
1587	    }
1588	    case "$resolved" in
1589	      claude-*) printf '%s\n' "copilot-model: --auto → $resolved  (Claude preferred)" >&2 ;;
1590	      *codex*|*Codex*) printf '%s\n' "copilot-model: --auto → $resolved  (no Claude; best Codex)" >&2 ;;
1591	      gpt-*|o[0-9]*) printf '%s\n' "copilot-model: --auto → $resolved  (no Claude/Codex; best GPT)" >&2 ;;
1592	      gemini-*) printf '%s\n' "copilot-model: --auto → $resolved  (no Claude/Codex/GPT; best Gemini)" >&2 ;;
1593	      *) printf '%s\n' "copilot-model: --auto → $resolved" >&2 ;;
1594	    esac
1595	    # $resolved already set — fall through to the write path below
1596	  # No arg + fzf available → interactive pick.
1597	  elif [ -z "$arg" ]; then
```
